resources.string: Allow “Display over other apps” for this app, then start the overlay.

For rooted BlueStacks: enable Root ON → restart BlueStacks → install this app → Start overlay → open Tuber Simulator → tap the red bubble. The menu auto-loads your live save. Edit values → APPLY LIVE SAVE & RESTART.\n\nUnity keeps prefs in memory, so a quick restart is required for new Bux/Gems to show.
